name: GCP Service Account Disabled, Deleted, or Modified
description: Service accounts are how GCP workloads prove who they are. Disabling or deleting one can halt pipelines (impact) or lock operators out of automation they needed to respond. Modifying the account — adding keys, changing who can impersonate it — can also be persistence. The same object is used for lockout and for takeover. Disable/delete of privileged service accounts should match a decommission ticket.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
